nest-angular-ssr.evidence: Johan accepted #737's separate Nest 12 feature and Nest 11 maintenance lines, patched Angular 22.2 baseline, and #748 maintenance-first ordering. The Nest 11 0.4.0 baseline is distributed. This successor excludes Nest 11 and Angular 21, requires Nest ~12.5.0, Angular ~22.2.6 / SSR ~22.2.7 and Node >=24.22.3 <25, while preserving the public SSR facade and Fastify behavior. See docs/validation/nest12-ssr-release-lines-737.md, nest12-ssr-certification-740.md and nest12-ssr-readiness-741.md. Nx must derive an unused breaking 0.x successor from complete published history. Initial channel: next; no Express/native Node support or latest promotion is claimed. Final versioned archive certification and protected release authorization remain required.

## 0.5.0 (2026-11-16)

### 🚀 Features

- ⚠️  **nest-angular-ssr:** support the Nest 12 Fastify line ([#756](https://github.com/anarchitects/anarchitecture-community/pull/756))

### 🩹 Fixes

- **nest-angular-ssr:** complete release packaging and consumer guidance ([#760](https://github.com/anarchitects/anarchitecture-community/pull/760), [#741](https://github.com/anarchitects/anarchitecture-community/issues/741))

### 📖 Documentation

- **nest-angular-ssr:** record Angular 21 sunset and release notes ([#763](https://github.com/anarchitects/anarchitecture-community/pull/763), [#742](https://github.com/anarchitects/anarchitecture-community/issues/742))

### 🏡 Chore

- **nest-angular-ssr:** prepare 0.5.0 Nest 12 release ([#773](https://github.com/anarchitects/anarchitecture-community/pull/773))

### ✅ Tests

- **nest-angular-ssr:** certify locked Fastify consumers ([#758](https://github.com/anarchitects/anarchitecture-community/pull/758))

### ⚠️  Breaking Changes

- **nest-angular-ssr:** support the Nest 12 Fastify line  ([#756](https://github.com/anarchitects/anarchitecture-community/pull/756))
  the feature line requires Nest12.5, Angular22.2.6/SSR22.2.7 and Node24.22.3+, excluding Nest11 and Angular21/22.1. Nest11 consumers remain on the separately maintained 0.3.x line. Release version and channels require the existing authorized Nx workflow."
